argformer_exclusion_reason: Published unique leaf-to-root paths use an ARG-specific ancestor-node vocabulary, masked-node pretraining and contrastive retrieval. Substituting whole-tree plus genomic attention would be a misleading comparator name; exact node-vocabulary training also breaks the common input ID-renaming contract.

Current repository supports log2 relative-distance transforms and joint-model GRU sequence processing. Implemented comparator follows v1 paper elapsed-generations clamp and single-tree computation.

adaptation_choices.feature_schema: all-node common 48 observed features; original observed features 0:8 followed by fixed reference summaries
adaptation_choices.relative_tables: independent learned relative Q/K/V tables shared across layers; never node-ID embedding
adaptation_choices.native_scope_ancestor_count: up to three available immediate ancestors
adaptation_choices.native_scope_ties: all reference cutoff ties included without arbitrary ID tie-breaking
adaptation_choices.native_scope_readout: learned CLS token with dedicated relation bin and linear 4-class head
adaptation_choices.normalization: pre-LayerNorm residual attention/FFN and final LayerNorm
adaptation_choices.native_tree_context: full observed tree receives all common features before internal subgraph selection; no independent truth/genotype fields
adaptation_choices.generic_control_relation: undirected shortest-path hop count, capped at32
adaptation_choices.parameter_comparability: equal hidden width is not equal parameter count because relative embedding tables differ
adaptation_choices.structural_preprocessing: CPU, detached observed edges/times, connected acyclic tree validation, O(n^2) pairwise LCA fill
adaptation_choices.cache: bounded4entries; tensor object identity/version counters for validity only; cached source tensors retained to avoid pointer reuse
adaptation_choices.attention_memory: occupied relation bins and scatter-add relative values avoid O(n^2*D) relation-value materialization
adaptation_choices.claims: engineering adaptation and control only; no ancestry-accuracy result or exact reproduction claim
